title: Sigma and pi in carbon dioxide
statement:
How many sigma and pi bonds does the Lewis structure O=C=O contain?

[_]{a}

explanations: Each of the two double bonds contributes one of each.
A double bond is not two sigma bonds.
It omits one O–C sigma connection.
Both double bonds have a pi component.

hints: There are two connected atom pairs.
Each double bond has one sigma component.
Each double bond also has one pi component.
solution: There are two connected atom pairs. Each double bond has one sigma component. Each double bond also has one pi component. Each of the two double bonds contributes one of each.
